About Me

About Me

Md. Mahfuzul Haque is an emerging researcher in Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE), with research interests spanning next-generation electronic devices and sustainable energy technologies.

Research

Research themes

Computational and device-oriented research aimed at improving performance, efficiency, and sustainability.

PV

Solar Cells & Photovoltaics

Lead-free and environmentally conscious photovoltaic architectures, device simulation, optimization, and next-generation absorber materials.

μ

Electronic & Optoelectronic Devices

Junctionless FETs, LEDs, and advanced semiconductor devices with emphasis on electronic and optoelectronic properties.

ML

Materials Modelling & AI

First-principles calculations and machine-learning approaches for screening materials and accelerating device design.

BIO

Biosensors & Drug Detection

Materials and device concepts for sensitive, selective, and computationally informed biosensing applications.

RE

Renewable Energy

Research aligned with sustainable energy technologies and the development of efficient, low-toxicity material systems.

DFT

First-Principles Device Physics

Electronic-structure and materials-property analysis used to guide practical device modelling and performance optimization.

Projects

Research & development projects

Selected project areas demonstrating the computational and device-oriented scope of the research group.

PROJECT 01

Lead-Free Perovskite Solar Cell Design

Design and optimization of double-absorber solar-cell architectures using SCAPS-1D, with emphasis on non-toxic materials and high device performance.

SCAPS-1DPVOptimization
PROJECT 02

DFT-Guided Materials Discovery

First-principles investigation of electronic, optical, and materials properties to identify promising candidates for future electronic and energy devices.

DFTMaterialsElectronic Structure
PROJECT 03

Machine Learning for Device Engineering

Data-driven prediction and screening workflows that connect calculated material properties with photovoltaic and electronic-device performance.

Machine LearningXGBoostData Science
PROJECT 04

Advanced Optoelectronic & Sensor Devices

Computational exploration of LEDs, junctionless transistors, biosensors, and related devices for emerging technological applications.

LEDJLFETBiosensor
